Sure! Here's the text I read:

Malini Mannath of Chennai Online wrote, "With a script of this type, the cast could hardly do much here. There is a lot of unintended humor, some of the shots are repeated over and over, the director seeming to lose track. I heard people behind me groan and mutter, praying in their anguish and fear. Then my waist was held by invisible hands and I was raised from the floor; at the height of the roof I was turned slowly parallel with the ground and then released so that I floated, immobile and face down."
